title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
snippet: Comprehensive substantive criminal code replacing core provisions of the IPC framework.

title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
snippet: Primary procedural criminal law statute replacing core CrPC framework.

title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023
snippet: Evidence law framework replacing core Indian Evidence Act structure.

title: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
snippet: Defines corruption offences and prosecution framework for public servants.

title: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
snippet: Special penal framework on narcotics offences, seizure, and stringent bail standards.

title: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
snippet: Special criminal law for child sexual offences with child-sensitive procedures.

title: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
snippet: Criminalizes caste-based atrocities and creates special procedural protections.

title: Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967
snippet: Framework on unlawful activities and terrorism-related offences.

title: Information Technology Act, 2000
snippet: Includes cyber offences and rules on electronic evidence and intermediary liability.

title: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
snippet: Arrest should be justified; police and magistrates must follow safeguards against routine arrest.

title: Lalita Kumari v. Government of Uttar Pradesh
snippet: FIR registration is mandatory for cognizable offences, with limited preliminary inquiry categories.

title: D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal
snippet: Laid down mandatory safeguards in arrest and detention to prevent custodial abuse.

title: State of Rajasthan v. Balchand
snippet: Classic articulation that bail is the rule and jail is the exception.

title: P. Chidambaram v. Directorate of Enforcement
snippet: Discusses balancing liberty and investigation needs in economic offence bail analysis.

title: Tofan Singh v. State of Tamil Nadu
snippet: Confessional statements to NDPS officers are treated with evidentiary limits under constitutional safeguards.

title: Satender Kumar Antil v. CBI
snippet: Comprehensive directions on bail, arrest discipline, and reduction of unnecessary incarceration.

title: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
snippet: Governs marriage validity, matrimonial relief, divorce, and related remedies among Hindus.

title: Special Marriage Act, 1954
snippet: Civil marriage framework irrespective of religion, with divorce and related relief provisions.

title: Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act, 1956
snippet: Rules for adoption among Hindus and maintenance obligations to specified dependents.

title: Hindu Succession Act, 1956
snippet: Intestate succession for Hindus; major interpretive questions on daughters' coparcenary rights.

title: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Divorce) Act, 1986
snippet: Statutory framework concerning rights and maintenance of divorced Muslim women.

title: Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act, 1939
snippet: Enumerates grounds on which a Muslim wife may obtain dissolution of marriage.

title: Guardians and Wards Act, 1890
snippet: General law on guardianship; welfare of child central in custody/guardianship decisions.

title: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
snippet: Civil-protective remedies in domestic relationships including residence and monetary relief.

title: Family Courts Act, 1984
snippet: Creates specialized Family Courts and conciliation-focused procedure for family disputes.

title: Shayara Bano v. Union of India
snippet: Set aside instant triple talaq (talaq-e-biddat) in key constitutional and personal-law ruling.

title: Danial Latifi v. Union of India
snippet: Interpreted 1986 Act to secure fair and reasonable provision for divorced Muslim women.

title: Shamim Ara v. State of U.P.
snippet: Clarified that valid talaq requires proper pronouncement and procedural fairness.

title: Sarla Mudgal v. Union of India
snippet: Held second marriage after conversion without dissolving first marriage attracts penal consequences.

title: Vineeta Sharma v. Rakesh Sharma
snippet: Affirmed equal coparcenary rights of daughters by birth under amended Hindu succession law.

title: Rajnesh v. Neha
snippet: Issued detailed maintenance adjudication guidelines and mandatory financial disclosure formats.

title: Gaurav Nagpal v. Sumedha Nagpal
snippet: Reiterated that child welfare is paramount in custody determination over strict parental claims.
